resources.string: Speeds up timeline, album and people thumbnails during this unlocked session. Encrypted on this device, with one storage limit for all profiles. Locking, switching profiles or going to the background destroys access and clears the cache, even during PIN grace. Originals and videos are never cached. Changes clear existing thumbnails.
